title: Card installments: show the remaining installments as future (upcoming) transactions; drop phantom pending installments after anticipation
description: Prod data (Itaú card): Pluggy sends one row per installment only when it is billed, with creditCardMetadata.installmentNumber/totalInstallments/purchaseDate (e.g. ACADEMIA ACQUA 02/12, CCT CLINICA CIR 01/04). Generate the remaining installments (n+1..N) as upcoming rows (same amount, monthly by bill cycle, not counted in the current balance), keyed idempotently by (card account, purchaseDate, description stem, installment k); when the real installment k arrives, it replaces its placeholder. Also: after an anticipation (DESC ANTECIPA PARCELAS), Itaú still lists the original installment as PENDING with a different id (PortovalleAcabame 04/04: POSTED 2026-09-06 and PENDING 2026-11-05, -13.339,13 counted twice); detect same purchaseDate+stem+installmentNumber already POSTED and skip the pending copy. Reuse the existing upcoming-occurrence concept (outputs.ts) for display.
notes:

Sync skips PENDING installment already POSTED (skipped_paid_installment).
